locations.note: Akiyama, Saejima, Tanimura and Kiryu untangle the 1985 Ueno Seiwa hit and a police plot to take Kamurocho, the series' Kabukicho, ending on the roof of the Millennium Tower.
Saejima escapes an island prison off Okinawa and washes up near Kiryu's orphanage, where Kiryu later beats the prison chief Saito.

routes.name: Four men, one conspiracy
routes.note: From Akiyama's Sky Finance in Kamurocho to Saejima's prison break off Okinawa, and from Kiryu's orphanage to the showdown on the Millennium Tower.
